target_customer: Adults with undiagnosed sleep apnea paying for diagnosis and treatment online
problem: About 90 percent of people with sleep apnea go untreated because diagnosis and treatment are hard to access.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth: app screening, doctor consults, home test and treatment shipped to the patient

founders.name: Darwin Lo
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. Prior employers not recorded because no opened source states them.

founders.name: Chris Turitzin
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. Prior employers not recorded because no opened source states them.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed a phone app that screens for apnea risk plus integration with doctors and a home diagnostic study ordered through the drchrono API, with US telehealth compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Telehealth plus shipped home tests could be copied by clinics and device makers; no stated proprietary data or license.

incumbents: Sleep clinics and home test providers
takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent reaction.

market_need_then: The company cites that about 90 percent of sleep apnea cases are untreated, and that access to diagnosis is a barrier.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand found. The word Wink is common and shared with unrelated products.

outcome_analysis: Wink Health reached the Winter 2015 batch with a sleep apnea telehealth model and recorded one small seed figure on a single aggregator. The domain now redirects to a domain sale page and directories list the company as inactive. No post-mortem or news about the end was found, so the cause of failure is not public.
notes: Funding search and cross-check: the $120,000 seed dated 2015-04-23 rests on one aggregator (Persana) and could not be confirmed elsewhere; no investors named. Website redirects to a HugeDomains sale page. Competitor search found no sources dated near 2015, so the list is empty. Branding search found no name origin or logo information. Founder employers seen in search snippets (Facebook, Fortify) were not from an opened source and are left null. Exit type shutdown follows YC status Inactive; date and reason unknown.
